comment: THE TAPE TIER EACH SNAPSHOT IS RELEASED AT (snapshot_bundle.py release).  A snapshot is recorded as needing the LEAST inclusive volume that runs its scenarios, and as accepting every more inclusive one.  Tiers are listed most inclusive first; a snapshot's 'tapeSha256Also' is the digests of the tiers before its own.  The first matching rule wins (fnmatch on 'SET/NAME').  The digests are the volumes' contents (OI340700-OPSn.7z are their encrypted forms): T1 = OPS1.7z, T1-no16 = OPS3.7z, T1-no136 = OPS2.7z.
